blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace, Reconciliation and Unity (OPAPRU) has conducted a post-assessment workshop to learn more about the lessons learned during the historic Bangsamoro parliamentary elections. In a statement on Sunday, the OPAPRU said the government peace mechanisms in the peace process with the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) conducted a workshop on October 27-29, just weeks after the historic September 14 BARMM parliamentary elections. It concluded right before the newly elected 80-member Parliament held its successful inaugural session on October 30.
